decisions.reason: This consumer food product is distant from the firm's chemical core, limiting its absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and improve the product.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions rely more on mechanical and civil engineering than on the firm's chemical knowledge, and the limited website presence suggests weak early learning signals.
Waste oil to energy builds directly on the firm's chemical processing and refining expertise, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn from early results and enhance the technology.
Plastic waste to fuel leverages the firm's polymer and petrochemical knowledge, enabling it to assimilate feedback and improve the process, so it is likely to be kept.
